Name: Pelican Town Accessibility - Handrails and  Wheelchair Ramps and Safer Footbridges
Author: MidnightVoyager
Description:
Ever wonder how George got to the Community Center for the opening? Or to the Ridgeside gathering? This mod adds accessible ramps with handrails to different staircases in town. It also now adds safer bridges.

Compatibility is quite a bit of work for these, so I haven't obliterated every step in town. (There's over seventy map patches for ten ramps, especially since I patch them into festivals as well!) My focus was on places that George goes first of all, which is how I scope creeped to do a few spots in Ridgeside. Secondly, I focused on main town areas and paths to transportation, like the railroad.
[color=#29292e]Content[/color]
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/38698/38698-1760906000-801089181.png[/img]﻿﻿[/center]
The staircases replaced are: The four big outdoor staircases in Pelican Town itself, the two that you would use to get to the railroad through the mountain, and the four staircases you would need to take to get to Ridgeside and up to Pika's. I have also added the stairs into Gus's Saloon, the stairs into the Community Center, the stairs inside the CC door, the stairs into the CC kids room, the stairs into the CC furnace room, and the steps up to the train platform. This includes the second platform from Pelican Town Utilities if you use that.

The bridges replaced are: All of the plank bridges in the forest, the Flower Dance, the mountain, the one added by the shortcuts upgrade in the mountain, and the one in town. The Flower Dance bridges have compatibility for the Flower Show and Gem Sea Shores.

You can control what staircases are replaced with ramps and what bridges are replaced in the config. I have made every single staircase and bridge configurable! Just mouseover the config options for further notes and description of what ramp or bridge it controls.
[color=#29292e]Tilesheets[/color]
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/41422/41422-1776064140-1471067797.png[/img]﻿﻿[/center]
The ramps themselves are vanilla tiles, but anyone is welcome to use this mod as a dependency to stick those railings wherever they like! I have a clean railing tilesheet and a rusty variant with some transparent-background holes to slap onto ramps for the broken down community center. There are recolors for the holes to match, but it's not likely anyone but me wants them for crappy, badly-maintained ramps. I have also made ramps and railings for the train station platform.
